answer_1.quote: We present a framework for building proactive and transition-aware conversational agents...

answer_2.quote: We adopt a transition-aware evaluation framework with three categories: TOD-centric measures... Mode Selection Accuracy and F1... Intent Detection Accuracy... Mode+Intent Joint Accuracy...

answer_3.quote: Each comparison is conducted either by an automatic judge (GEMINI-2.5-PRO)... The judge outputs a Win/Tie/Lose decision for each criterion...

answer_4.quote: In parallel, the human study was conducted on a 77-sample subset... with judgments provided either by an LLM evaluator or by human annotators (10 evaluators, including both NLP practitioners and general users).
answer_4.guideline: annotators evaluated responses without a tie option... following criteria: 'Does the response make sense?', 'Is the response specific?', 'Is the response interesting?', 'Is the transition natural?'
